name: DH-X heavy blaster rifle
description: The DH-X heavy blaster rifle was a cumbersome model of long-range heavy blaster rifle that was designed to punch a hole the size of a smashball through any target within sight. The weapon had a short and squat barrel with a durasteel finish and a long, rectangular emitter nozzle. This was unusual for a heavy blaster, as most had designs with long, thin barrels. DH-Xs came standard with a buttstock made of solid composite alloy and a monocular targeting optics suite.
